title: Koh Lanta vs Koh Phangan: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Koh Lanta for quiet beaches and romance, Koh Phangan for the Full Moon Party and digital nomad scene. Different coasts, different vibes — pick based on your travel style.

categories.name: Beaches
categories.summary: Koh Lanta has long, uncrowded Andaman Sea beaches. Koh Phangan has a mix — party beaches in the south, pristine in the north.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Koh Phangan hosts the Full Moon Party (30,000 people). Koh Lanta is quiet with a few beach bars.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Koh Lanta is marginally cheaper — ฿700–1,200/day vs ฿900–1,600/day on Phangan.

categories.name: Digital Nomads
categories.summary: Koh Phangan has better coworking infrastructure and a larger expat/nomad community.

categories.name: Season
categories.summary: Koh Phangan's Gulf coast has a longer season (Nov–Sep). Koh Lanta is only good Nov–Apr.

categories.name: Couples
categories.summary: Koh Lanta is the top romantic island choice — quiet, private beaches, sunset dinners.

categories.name: Nature
categories.summary: Koh Lanta has Mu Ko Lanta National Park and excellent snorkeling day trips to Koh Rok.

categories.name: Wellness
categories.summary: Koh Phangan has an established yoga and wellness retreat scene, especially in Srithanu.

faq.question: Is Koh Lanta or Koh Phangan better for couples?
faq.answer: Koh Lanta is the clear winner for couples — quiet beaches, sunset dinners, and zero party noise.

faq.question: Which is cheaper, Koh Lanta or Koh Phangan?
faq.answer: Koh Lanta is marginally cheaper — about ฿200–300/day less for comparable accommodation and food.
